newsitem.title: UK: Unisys wins CCC mobile data collection tend.
newsitem.headline: Unisys wins CCC mobile data collection tend.

text.p: Unisys Corporation said that is has been awarded a contract to deliver a mobile data collection solution for Cargo Centre Copenhagen (CCC), the second largest ground handling agent in Copenhagen.
Acting as systems integrator, Unisys will deliver a wireless network to improve CCC's cargo tracking capability and reduce its operating costs throughout the entire handling process.

The system will use a combination of bar-code and pen-based data input linked to a wireless LAN. The system will track cargo through each "event" in the freight handling process - acceptance of cargo, delivery to the warehouse, assignment to a flight, check-in on arrival, storage and receipt by customer.
The wireless data collection solution should eliminate paper-based cargo tracking at CCC.
CCC handles freight operations for 31 airlines and is a subsidiary of Maersk, the largest owner of ocean tankers and container ships.
CCC will also use the new system for its special air freight service allowing deliveries at the airport as little as one hour before flight time.
"Our cargo business has expanded rapidly and we now handle more than 200 incoming and outgoing flights a day," CCC manager, Henrik Ambak, said.

"We need an automated system that will help up speed up the freight forwarding process with less paper and forms and to reduce our costs," he added. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
